segments.name: Americas
segments.description: Hotel search and price comparison platform serving Argentina, Brazil, Canada, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Mexico, Peru, United States and Uruguay.
segments.evidence: Our Americas segment is comprised of Argentina, Brazil, Canada, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Mexico, Peru, the United States and Uruguay.

segments.name: Developed Europe
segments.description: Hotel search and price comparison platform serving Austria, Belgium, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, Netherlands, Norway, Portugal, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland and United Kingdom.
segments.evidence: Our Developed Europe segment is comprised of Austria, Belgium, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, the Netherlands, Norway, Portugal, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland and the United Kingdom.

segments.name: Rest of World
segments.description: Hotel search and price comparison platform serving all other countries including Japan, Turkey, Australia, New Zealand and Poland.
segments.evidence: Our RoW segment is comprised of all other countries, the most significant by revenue of which are Japan, Turkey, Australia, New Zealand and Poland.

revenueModel.text: Advertisers including OTAs, hotel chains and independent hotels pay for referrals when users click offers and are referred to their booking websites.
revenueModel.evidence: When they click on an offer for a hotel room or other accommodation at a certain price, they are referred to our advertisers' websites where they can complete their booking.

changes.text: In 2025, trivago acquired Holisto Ltd, renamed trivago DEALS Ltd, an AI-driven hotel rate aggregator and white-label booking engine provider.
changes.evidence: We completed the strategic acquisition of Holisto Ltd (renamed to trivago DEALS Ltd) in July 2025.
